office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Jenny Zappone is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County District Court judge since 2022 and a former senior deputy prosecutor; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Judge since 2022; former senior deputy prosecutor and victim-advocate unit supervisor [S1]
Started a language-access committee spanning the Municipal, District and Superior courts [S1]
Cites a grant for evidence-based domestic-violence treatment won while she ran the DV docket [S1]
